Docs / CLI Reference

CLI Reference

Command line utilities for architectural governance, turns, materialization, and verification.

afwe turn begin "<prompt>" --target <files>

Starts a turn, computes file baseline hashes, and outputs turn briefing (pins, scoped nodes, active guardrails).

afwe turn assume <turn> --file <json>

Registers intents and AST claims before the agent modifies code. Rejects undeclared targets or schema errors.

afwe turn commit <turn>

Runs deterministic leaf-to-root validation, executes registered checks, checks pins & collateral losses, and commits to git with AFWE-Turn trailer.

afwe materialize

Previews or applies tamper-proof BLAKE3 manifest (.afwe/guardrails/manifest.yaml), chained pre-commit hooks, and CI workflows.

afwe unlock --reason "<reason>" / afwe lock

Toggles Explore Mode: downgrades blocking checks to advisory warnings for rapid prototyping spikes; lock re-arms gates.

afwe sync

Performs Tree-Sitter parsing across source code, detects drift, reconciles mapped nodes, and updates index.

afwe stats

Prints gate metrics, AST parse durations, model calibration profiles, and rubric accuracy telemetry.

afwe studio

Launches the visual AFWE Studio web interface on http://localhost:4242.

afwe docs

Serves the official documentation and concepts website locally on http://localhost:4243.

afwe mcp

Runs the stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 Model Context Protocol (MCP) server providing 57 architectural tools to coding harnesses.
